description: List every Learnosity integration skill: a curated, step-by-step guide to building one integration across several APIs. Returns the whole catalog, with no limit, as entries of id, title, goal, apis and resource_uri; bodies are not included. Use it to browse the catalog or pick skills by API. To find a skill by topic or free text use skills_search instead, then skills_read with the chosen id for the full guide.

apis.description: Keep only skills that declare every API listed (all must match, case-insensitive), e.g. ["items-api", "reports-api"]. Omit for the whole catalog.

name: skills_list
title: List Integration Skills
